title: Ext pullback map on chosen resolution sections
statement: Let $g:X^{\prime}\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], $G$ an abelian sheaf on $X_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], and $q\in\mathbb N$. Let $L=g^{-1}$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image], $\Gamma=\Gamma(X,-)$, and $\Gamma^{\prime}=\Gamma(X^{\prime},-)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. Write $s:G[0]\to I$ and $t:(LG)[0]\to J$ for the chosen injective resolutions [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Let $\varphi:LI\to J$ be a chain map with $L(s);\varphi$ homotopic to the composite of the canonical single-complex isomorphism $L(G[0])\cong (LG)[0]$ and $t$. Let $\eta:\Gamma\to L\Gamma^{\prime}$ be the unit section map followed by $\Gamma(X,g_*(-))\cong\Gamma(X^{\prime},-)$, and let $b=\eta(I);\Gamma^{\prime}(\varphi)$. For the explicitly defined comparisons $a$ of [def-weil-pbc-ext-resolution-sections-iso], we have $a_{X,G,q};H^q(b)=\operatorname{cohomologyMap}(g,G,q);a_{X^{\prime},LG,q}$ [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback].

source.place: cohomology.tex lemma-functoriality; equations equation-functorial-derived (01F9) and equation-functorial (01FA); derived.tex lemma-compute-ext-resolutions (06XR). The site analogue uses sites-cohomology.tex remark-before-Leray (08J6).

proof.text: Represent an Ext class by a cocycle into I using Ext computed by an injective resolution. Apply exact inverse image and precompose the constant-integer-sheaf comparison, then postcompose with the supplied lift φ. Its augmentation homotopy identifies this cocycle with the Ext pullback in the derived category, because the target J is K-injective.

Evaluation at 1 identifies the inverse-image cocycle with the section unit η(I). Evaluation is natural under φ by the constant-sheaf/global-sections adjunction, so this is precisely b on sections. The evaluation chain isomorphism preserves differentials and boundaries. Descend the equality of cocycles to homology; the explicit a is the composite of exactly these equivalences.
